questions.question: What did God say to Jeremiah about before he was born?
options: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and appointed you a prophet to the nations
You would one day sit upon the throne of David and rule over all of the land
From your earliest youth you would walk faithfully in all the ways of your fathers before you
You would serve as a priest in the house of the LORD all the days of your life
questions.answer: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and appointed you a prophet to the nations

questions.question: What two visions did Jeremiah see at his call?
options: A green vine and a basket of ripe summer figs
A flying scroll and a sharpened sword of judgment
An almond branch and a boiling pot facing from the north
A roaring lion and a gentle young lamb lying down together
questions.answer: An almond branch and a boiling pot facing from the north
